name: jev-rules
description: Jev picks which of your rules apply to each prompt, so Claude only sees the ones that matter.

pane_opens.title: Rules pane opens
pane_opens.description: Early access: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. on-first-pick opens the rules pane by itself the first time Jev picks a rule in a session, when the window is wide enough to show it beside the conversation. only-with-command waits for /rules.
